title: antennaria alpina var. stolonifera
intro: Antennaria alpina var. stolonifera, commonly known as mountain everlasting, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Antennaria alpina var. stolonifera include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and caffeic acid derivatives. The bioactive constituents of Antennaria alpina var. stolonifera have been found to have antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects, further supporting its traditional use in folk medicine.
